hero.heading: Mentors with Global Expertise
hero.subheading: Culinary training at Culinary Academy is led by Executive Chefs with decades of experience in global 5-star hospitality markets.

mentors.name: Dewan Ismail
mentors.title: Principal & Director of Career Planning & Development
mentors.bio: Dewan Ismail is the Principal of Culinary Academy and an authoritative voice in culinary education. He specializes in Culinary Science, ISO-HACCP & Hygiene, and Career Development. With a BBA and MBA from Jagannath University, he bridges professional kitchen standards with technical excellence.

mentors.name: Rafeya Chowdhury
mentors.title: Lead Trainer
mentors.bio: As Lead Trainer at Culinary Academy, Rafeya Chowdhury brings elite 5-star hospitality standards. Her career includes tenure as Chef de Partie at The Westin and years of executive instruction. She is a recognized culinary voice on BTV and Jamuna TV.

mentors.name: Rehana Akhter Poly
mentors.title: Associate Executive Trainer
mentors.bio: Rehana Akhter Poly specializes in Food & Beverage production and Bakery & Pastry arts. Her technical standards in Food Art are recognized by international culinary bodies.

mentors.name: Asifa Rashid Rayta
mentors.title: Theoretical Instructor & Head of Operations
mentors.bio: Asifa Rashid Rayta bridges administrative excellence and theoretical mastery at Culinary Academy, bringing structured academic rigor and compliance to kitchen operations.

mentors.name: Abu Baqur Siddik
mentors.title: Assistant Trainer
mentors.bio: Abu Baqur Siddik focuses on foundational culinary techniques and practical lab assistance, ensuring every student masters the core physical skills required in high-pressure commercial kitchens.

mentors.name: Salman Iqbal
mentors.title: Brand Manager
mentors.bio: Salman Iqbal orchestrates the Culinary Academy brand identity and institutional communication, ensuring that Culinary Academy's mission of vocational excellence is communicated across all platforms.
